required_fields.source_hash_sha256: Null until raw export byte coverage verified
required_fields.export_receipt_ref: Null until independently verified source export receipt

crawl_sequence: Explicitly select a permitted Notion root; do not infer consent from a search hit
Read provider metadata for exact page ID, parent, title, rights and modified timestamp
Check user and workspace grants, child-page scope and source classification
Enumerate child pages and blocks, following every returned cursor to exhaustion
Preserve inaccessible/denied pages as unknown or missing-access pointers, never claim they do not exist
Export original bytes only if authorized; record actual scope and raw_export_status
Compute SHA-256 over captured exact bytes and retain export-path and provider timestamp evidence
Cross-check counts, child IDs, duplicates, attachments, and parent-child consistency
Route sensitive and contradictory source claims to private human review
Create only candidate graph links; never infer canon, deployment, shared identity or source-of-truth authority
non_claims: No live Notion fetch or private account interrogation occurred
No inferred completeness or data-rights permissions
No automatic movement of private Social/Play/Imagine/Dream/Quiet bodies into Work
